explication: Claude Subconscious is a Claude Code plugin that runs background hooks to share session context with a persistent Letta agent and surface guidance back to Claude. The main loop starts or reuses a Letta conversation, reads and formats transcript updates, sends them asynchronously through the Letta Code SDK, then injects agent messages or memory updates before prompts and tool use. The README also documents agent setup and model selection, shared cross-project memory, and agent access to code and web tools. Some hook wiring and implementation details are not shown in the excerpts; unsampled relationships are omitted.
